summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by DeFi Technologies, a foreign private issuer, announcing an extension of the proxy voting deadline for its annual general and special meeting to June 28, 2026, to ensure a quorum. The meeting itself is a standard shareholder event with no special-situation corporate action. The filing is a procedural notice and administrative update, not a trigger for any special-situations category. No deal terms, strategic review, or activist campaign are present. The only notable event is the meeting reminder, which falls outside the special-situations scope.
